All eight labels are visible: A, O, O1, X, x, x_m, phi and omega_0. No Cyrillic or Chinese wording, cultural imagery, numeric angle, numeric radius, task alternative or answer annotation is added.

The full modern lesson describes the positive-axis initial radius, phi=omega_0 t and x=x_m cos(phi), then the circular-motion shadow and spring comparison. The depicted later upper-left radius, upward projection, vertical phase reference and full-radius amplitude agree with that complete context.
